description:
A good 30L hiking backpack solves the most common problem on Kenyan day hikes: a small school bag that cannot fit a rain jacket, three litres of water and lunch, or a huge rucksack that is overkill for a day on the trail. Weather on Mt Kenya, the Aberdares and Ngong Hills can turn from hot sun to cold rain within an hour, so you need space for layers without hauling a 60-litre bag.

This Millet 30L hiking backpack sits right in that middle ground. Thirty litres is enough to carry everything a full day out demands, yet the bag stays compact and close to your back on steep sections. It comes from Millet, a French mountain brand that has been making climbing and hiking gear in the Alps for more than a century, so it is built with real mountain days in mind.

Why Choose This Millet 30L Hiking Backpack?

Millet was founded in 1921 by Marc and Hermance Millet and moved to Annecy, in the French Alps, in 1929. In the 1960s the company turned its focus to mountaineering backpacks, developing its early designs with French alpinist Louis Lachenal and with Walter Bonatti as technical advisor. That heritage shows in how Millet packs are shaped: simple, tough and made to be carried for long hours.

A 30L hiking backpack is also the most versatile size you can own. It handles a Saturday hike, a weekday commute and a weekend away. If you want something slightly smaller for short trails, compare it with our 28L day hiking backpack, and for multi-day treks step up to the 65L Outlander rucksack.

Key Features

  • 30-litre capacity, the sweet spot for full-day hikes and light overnight trips
  • Made by Millet, a French mountain brand founded in 1921
  • From a brand that has designed mountaineering backpacks since the 1960s
  • Room for water, rain shell, warm layer, lunch and a first aid kit
  • Compact enough for matatu, boda and carry-on travel
  • Quality branded gear at a fair Nairobi price

Benefits of a 30L Hiking Backpack

Here is what a 30L hiking backpack from a trusted brand gives you on the trail.

  • Carries a full day's kit: Water, food, a rain shell, a fleece, a headlamp and first aid all fit without stuffing.
  • Stays close to your body: A mid-size load is easier to balance on rocky scrambles and steep descents.
  • One bag, many uses: Use it for hiking, travel, the gym or the daily commute in Nairobi.
  • Trusted mountain brand: Millet gear is designed and tested in the Alps.
  • Light overnight option: Pack smart and a 30L hiking backpack can handle a hut night or a simple camp.

Perfect For

  • Day hikers who want more room than a small daypack
  • Guided group hikes where you carry your own water and lunch
  • Summit days on longer treks, with the main bag left at camp
  • Travellers who want one carry-on bag for a short trip
  • Students and commuters who need a strong, roomy everyday bag

Where to Use Your 30L Hiking Backpack in Kenya

Take it up Ngong Hills, Mt Longonot, Elephant Hill in the Aberdares, Kinangop or Sleeping Warrior, where a full day out needs two to three litres of water and a warm layer for the summit. It is also the right size for summit day on Mt Kenya, when you leave the big pack at Shipton's or Mintos and climb light to Point Lenana.

Away from the mountains, it works for Karura Forest walks, Hell's Gate cycling and hiking days, Kakamega Forest trails and coastal trips to Diani or Watamu. A 30L hiking backpack is easy to stow on a matatu or under a bus seat, which makes it a handy travel bag too.

Whatever bag you carry, pack the basics. The Ten Essentials list from the US National Park Service is a reliable checklist for what should be inside your pack on every hike, from navigation and sun protection to extra water and emergency shelter. Pair it with good socks and a rain layer and you are ready for most Kenyan trails.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is a 30L hiking backpack big enough for a day hike?

Yes. A 30L hiking backpack comfortably holds water, food, a rain jacket, a warm layer and a first aid kit, which is everything most day hikes in Kenya need.

Can I use it for an overnight hike?

For a hut or banda night, yes, if you pack light. For camping with a tent, sleeping bag and stove, a 45-65L pack is a better choice.

Who makes Millet backpacks?

Millet is a French outdoor brand founded in 1921 and based in Annecy in the French Alps. It has made mountaineering backpacks since the 1960s.
